bill.title: A bill to guarantee the right to vote for all citizens regardless of conviction of a criminal offense, and for other purposes.
bill.latestActionText: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

classification.plainSummary: This bill would restore voting rights to all U.S. citizens regardless of whether they have been convicted of a criminal offense. It would prohibit states from denying or restricting the right to vote based on criminal conviction status, effectively ending felony disenfranchisement laws. The bill would apply to federal, state, and local elections.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation.
